coverage_assessment.live_step_overlay: covered — AC-1/AC-4 test asserts projection.step/role/concurrentSteps become the live engine values when a live active task exists
coverage_assessment.consistency_with_catalog_detail: covered structurally — same core functions (resolveLiveNodesByInstance/overlayLiveSteps) reused unmodified (0-line core diff), no new consistency test needed since it's provably the same code path already tested in process-catalog-view.test.ts/processes-live-instances.test.ts
coverage_assessment.repro_closure: covered — AC-2 test explicitly proves the phantom step WITHOUT the overlay (snapshot default), then proves the same instance WITH the overlay converges to the live step, not the phantom
coverage_assessment.degrade_paths: covered — 4 distinct degrade scenarios tested: engine error (ok:false), empty active-task list, bare client (no getActiveUserTasks method), and no flowableClient injected at all; all assert 200 + projection present + step stays off the live value
coverage_assessment.defer_agent_rows_not_broken: not directly exercised by a new test, but verified analytically (see review.json c_defer_agent_untouched) — defer/agent rows never populate `projection` in the first place (findWaitingInstanceTask/listInstanceProjections both keyed off real Flowable instance ids/inboxTaskId that defer rows don't have), so overlayInboxDetailLiveStep is structurally unreachable for them; pre-existing inbox-detail.test.ts (5/5 green) and the full inbox test surface provide regression coverage that defer/seed rows still 200
coverage_assessment.deadline_budget: not re-tested at the inbox.ts wrapper level (thin pass-through of the same LIVE_OVERLAY_DEADLINE_MS constant into resolveLiveNodesByInstance), but the underlying deadline-race logic is already unit-tested at the core level in process-catalog-view.test.ts (T-0709-R-P2-1) — reasonable scoping, not a coverage gap given the wrapper adds no new logic around the deadline

non_blocking.note: Нет прямого HTTP-теста 'defer-задача → projection остаётся null/absent, оверлей не трогает её' — вывод сделан анализом кода (structural), не наблюдением через реальный inbox-detail-live-step тест на defer-фикстуре. Не блокирует (существующий inbox-detail.test.ts покрывает detail route в целом, defer-семантика вне изменённых строк), но будущий регресс в findWaitingInstanceTask/listInstanceProjections matching logic не поймается этим новым файлом.
